reviews.comment: Lectures are what is on exams, so attendance isn't mandatory. Miss at your own risk. I missed a few times and it wasn't a big deal. Entire class is 2 exams, 2 case studies, and a final, but he is a very easy grader. Study a lot for the exams and you will be totally fine. You can tell he really enjoys what he does. Easy B, work for the A.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things
